title: Cute Cups!
text: Cute Cups!. These are decent plastic cups. They are fairly sturdy. The decoration is pretty. I don't think they're super high quality, but they are affordable. I have been using them outside and they are ideal for that. I like seeing new items in the Vera Bradley product line.
